# StackSnap: Tech Stack Detector

StackSnap is a professional Chrome extension for detecting website technologies.

## Features
- Detects 100+ technologies (React, Vue, WordPress, Shopify, etc.)
- Categorized analysis: Frameworks, Analytics, CMS, Hosting.
- Local execution for privacy.
- Lightweight and fast.

## Links
- Homepage: https://stacksnap.vercel.app
- Privacy Policy: https://stacksnap.vercel.app/privacy
- Chrome Web Store: [Pending]

## Technical
- Built with Manifest V3.
- Vanilla JavaScript core.
- No external tracking.
